name: The Brookfield
stayType: Boutique B&B in a Georgian house
accommodation: Five en-suite rooms for up to 10 guests
suitableFor: Couples and friends; not suitable for pets
boardStorage: Secure storage for surfboards, bikes and golf bags; wetsuit drying
confirmedFeatures: Breakfast included, free WiFi, guest drawing room, garden and conservatory, e-bike charging
overview: A B&B in a Georgian house built in 1798 on South Street, about 400 metres from Braunton village centre and close to the Tarka Trail. Its five en-suite rooms sleep up to ten, breakfast is included and there is a free private car park.
surfTripFit: Secure board storage and wetsuit drying are rare in a B&B, and Saunton is about four miles away.
